title: Reconciliation
subtitle: Whether the Reporting Center agrees with itself, and by how much it deliberately differs from accounting.

status.passHint: Every screen that answers the same question returns the same number, to within {{tolerance}}.
status.failHint: At least one pair of screens disagrees. Every figure derived from a failing check is suspect until it is resolved.
status.partialHint: Some checks could not run. The ones that ran all agree.

internal.title: Internal checks
internal.subtitle: Screens that answer the same question from the same canon must agree to the cent. A failure here is a defect, not a rounding difference.

declared.title: Deliberate differences from accounting
declared.subtitle: These are meant to differ. The Reporting Center corrects defects the accounting layer still carries, so the gap is the correction working — a difference of zero would be the suspicious result.
declared.unavailable: The accounting profit and loss could not be read, so the deliberate differences could not be measured. The internal checks above are unaffected.
declared.corrections: Corrections applied by the Reporting Center

correction.discountDoubleCount: Discount is counted once, from the all-inclusive column, instead of being added twice.
correction.exchangeRecognition: An exchange order recognises what the customer actually paid, not the full replacement value.
correction.softDeletedExcluded: Soft-deleted orders are excluded from revenue.
correction.draftStatusExcluded: Draft-like statuses, including AI drafts, are excluded from revenue.
correction.draftExpensesExcluded: Draft expenses are excluded from expenses.

customers.customerRevenuePlusWalkIns: Customer revenue plus walk-ins equals net sales

inventory.demandWithinSales: Inventory demand is within total sales

note.walkIns: Orders with no customer record are added back, because they are real revenue that cannot be attributed to a customer.
note.stockedOnly: Inventory demand covers only products with stock on hand right now, so it is always a subset of total sales rather than equal to it.
note.headerLine: A purchase header carries tax and header discount; the sum of its lines need not match. Spend uses the header, and anything per product uses the lines.
note.discountNotPublished: The Reporting Center does not publish a standalone discount total; it is already deducted inside net sales.
note.cogsNotPublishedSeparately: The Reporting Center does not publish a standalone cost of goods total; it is already deducted inside gross profit.

warnings.title: Data quality notes from every report
warnings.subtitle: Everything the individual screens raised, gathered in one place.
warnings.empty: No screen raised a data-quality note for this period.

states.error: The reconciliation could not be run.
states.forbidden: You do not have access to reports.
